# Carbon

> Carbon is Hugging Face's open-source family of autoregressive genomic foundation models for DNA. Three sizes (500M, 3B, and 8B parameters), a 393,216 bp context window, a 6-mer BPE tokenizer, and 1 trillion training tokens spanning the tree of life. Model weights, training code, and the data pipeline are all open source on the Hugging Face Hub.

This site is the interactive editorial walkthrough of what the 3B checkpoint learned. It is organised into four tabs:

- **Intro** — a short primer on what the model reads (the four bases of DNA, helices, genes, splicing, translation) and a guided tour of the rest of the page.
- **DNA Lab** — five live sections that hit the deployed 3B model: streaming continuation of an arbitrary DNA prefix, per-token likelihood scoring, in-silico variant effect prediction (VEP), ESMFold-based protein folding over Carbon-decoded ORFs, and a UMAP scatter of ~500,000 gene embeddings.
- **Carbon Recipe** — the training story: tokenizer design, the hybrid loss, the dataset mixture, the species tree learned from per-species mean embeddings, the long-context training schedule, and the headline results.
- **Sandbox** — a minimal prompt-and-stream UI for running Carbon on arbitrary DNA sequences without leaving the page.

## Demo

- [Live interactive demo (this site)](/): Editorial scrollytell across Intro / DNA Lab / Carbon Recipe / Sandbox.
- [Standalone sandbox](/sandbox-only): The DNA continuation UI without the surrounding editorial.

## Models

- [HuggingFaceBio/Carbon-3B](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceBio/Carbon-3B): The default 3B checkpoint used by every live interaction on this page.
- [HuggingFaceBio organisation page](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceBio): Full list of Carbon model sizes (500M, 3B, 8B) and related artefacts.

## Code

- [github.com/huggingface/carbon](https://github.com/huggingface/carbon): Training and inference code.

## Data

- [HuggingFaceBio/carbon-inference-evals](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceBio/carbon-inference-evals): The evaluation dataset behind the headline numbers shown in the Results section.

## API

The demo's FastAPI backend exposes a small set of JSON endpoints that crawlers and agents may find useful. They are designed for the frontend but are not gated:

- `POST /generate` — streaming DNA continuation. Body: `{"prompt": "ACGT...", "max_tokens": 128, "temperature": 0.5, "top_p": 0.9}`. Returns Server-Sent Events.
- `POST /score` — per-token log-probabilities over a forced sequence. Body: `{"sequence": "ACGT...", "max_window": 24000}`.
- `POST /fold` — ESMFold-based protein structure prediction. Body: `{"sequence": "<AMINO_ACIDS>"}`. Returns PDB plus mean pLDDT.
- `GET /config` — the model identifier currently served.
- `GET /umap`, `GET /umap_labels`, `GET /umap_names`, `GET /highlights`, `GET /species_tree`, `GET /genes`, `GET /variants`, `GET /species` — static data payloads powering the visualisations.
